LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. goed

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Poetry 2.2.1 Types of Poetry: Form and Structure Types of poems: - Concrete - Ac.
